sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 359)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio, armed forces syndication, and Australian drama, Jack Benny & Mary Livingstone on *The Jell-O Program* with George Olsen's orchestra (1932), Rudy Vallee welcoming dialect comedian Alan Reed & Xavier Cugat for Sealtest (1940), Charles Boyer as an international courier in postwar Venice (1950), Brian Aherne in *The Saint*, the USAF Band's *Serenade in Blue*, and Australian stage drama on *WCRS Radio Stage* (1932–2000):
